title: Margin Call (9/9) Movie CLIP - It's Just Money (2011) HD
summary: A clip from the 2011 film Margin Call in which a firm's CEO, played by Jeremy Irons, tells a senior executive about the cycles of financial crashes. Kevin Spacey's character says he wants out, and the scene ends on the line that it is just money.
why: HN shares it in bubble and crash threads as a memorable scene about market cycles and about information work versus physical labor.

quote.text: It's a great scene and line that's always stayed with me.
